note: A 12-site gravel park in Somerset across from a golf course, a few minutes from Lake Cumberland's marinas, for self-contained rigs only. Freeze precautions are required in winter. Sites include a satellite TV hookup. --Claude
summary: Kept with flags. 12 full-hookup sites, self-contained only (no bathhouse), year-round, phone booking with drive-ins welcome, 3-night holiday minimum. Only rate posted is the operator's '2023 price' $30 (passes the gate even with increases). Long-term stays accepted by arrangement; imagery shows all 12 pads filled, nightly share unmeasurable. Google 4.2/48.
flags: STALE RATE: the only rate the operator posts is labeled '2023 price $30.00' ($33.09 with tax). Written with fees.checked 2023. Price gate passes comfortably.

Long-stay check (borderline, flag only): 'Longer term stay type occupancies will need to be discussed ... as there are certain requirements' and Wi-Fi only 'for longer term stays'; Esri imagery shows every one of the 12 pads occupied by RVs. But the operator sells nightly with a deposit, 'Drive ins are welcome', posts no monthly/seasonal rates, and minimums are holiday-only. Nightly share cannot be measured from the site; Google 4.2/48 is the weakest rating in the batch.
